steps.what: Perform the laboratory test on the collected sample.
File the wastewater result when the sample id exists.
Check the contaminated content figure before it is reported.

tasks.design: The inspector performs the laboratory test on the collected sample, including the content of contaminated wastewater. The result is filed in {DOCS} only when the sample id and the value are present. The inspector checks the figure before it is reported. A result with no sample id is not filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Results were written beside the bench and filed later against the wrong sample.
tasks.enabler_now: A result that already has a sample id can be filed once.
tasks.still_hard: A test the method does not cover, and a figure that does not match the sample.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see a tidy number on a sample that was not the one collected.
tasks.altitude: A numbered result can be filed once. The inspector still performs the test and still checks the figure. An unnumbered result stays at the bench.

reach.task: File a test result against the sample id and still run the test.
reach.learn: The filing can be prepared. The test stays here.

evidence.claim: A laboratory result with a sample id can be filed once. It cannot perform the test.
The site visit, the sample, and the interview stay with the inspector. A stored reading is not a finding. A label is not a sample.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.
Fields: Sample id and result value, produced by the bench note. A result with no sample id is not filed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the sample register the organisation already keeps.
unknowns: Which tests are done in this laboratory.
Who may report a result besides the inspector.
research_questions: What share of results already have a sample id?
Which tests are always done by the inspector?

already_counted.description: The inspector still performs the laboratory test.
The inspector still checks the figure before it is reported.

incremental.description: The inspector repeats a test whose sample id was wrong.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is filing a result that already has a sample id. It disappears when the id is missing and the inspector files it by hand. Performing the laboratory test stays with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assemble stored water results that have a sample id.
Inform owners and the public about the wastewater pollution.
Note which harmful properties were actually explained.

tasks.design: Stored water results that have a sample id are assembled in {DOCS} before the briefing. The inspector informs health professionals, property owners, and the public about the harmful properties and the wastewater pollution. The note records what was actually explained. A result with no sample id is not put on the sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: Briefings used a result from a neighbouring sample because the sheet was out of date.
tasks.enabler_now: Results already stored against a sample id can be the ones in the room.
tasks.still_hard: A question about a property the results do not cover, and a harm the sheet does not name.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can tell that a correct result will be misunderstood without an explanation.
tasks.altitude: The stored results are in the briefing. The inspector still informs the owners and the public. The sheet is not sent as the explanation.

reach.task: Bring the stored result to a public explanation and still give the explanation.
reach.learn: The sheet can be assembled. The conversation stays here.

evidence.claim: Stored results with a sample id can be assembled for a briefing. They cannot explain the pollution to an owner.
A record is filed only when the required ids are already stored. A drafted sentence may cite only a figure or a rule already in the file. A sentence with neither stops.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.

Fields: Sample id and result value, produced by the result record. A result with no sample id is not put on the sheet. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the results the organisation already stores.
unknowns: Which audiences must be told in person.
Who else may speak for the organisation.
research_questions: What share of results have a sample id?
Which briefings are always done by the inspector?

already_counted.description: The inspector still informs the owners and the public.
The inspector still notes what was explained.

incremental.description: The inspector explains a result the sheet did not include.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is assembling results that already have a sample id. It disappears when the id is missing and the inspector hunts for the result. Informing the owners and the public stays with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List missing fields on the discharge permit application.
Evaluate the registration of products with dangerous materials.
Record the pollution control finding the inspector accepts.

tasks.design: Missing fields on a discharge permit or a product registration are listed from {DOCS} against the required field ids. The inspector evaluates applications for products containing dangerous materials and for pollution control permits. A complete field list does not grant the permit. The inspector records the finding that is accepted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applications were read in full to discover that a required annex was absent.
tasks.enabler_now: Missing required fields can be listed before the inspector evaluates the substance.
tasks.still_hard: A complete form for a product that should not be registered, and a discharge the fields do not describe.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see a complete application that still should not be allowed.
tasks.altitude: Missing fields are visible first. The inspector still evaluates the application and still records the finding. A complete form is not an approval.

reach.task: List the missing fields and still evaluate the application.
reach.learn: The gap list can be prepared. The evaluation stays here.

evidence.claim: Missing required fields can be listed from an application. The list cannot evaluate a dangerous product or grant a discharge permit.

A field compare does not register a product, approve a discharge, or change a procedure. The inspector decides, including that no action is taken. EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with a legal effect.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.

Fields: Application id and required field id, produced by the application form. A form with no field ids is not checked. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the application checklist the organisation already keeps.
unknowns: Who signs a permit besides the inspector.
research_questions: What share of applications use the field checklist?

already_counted.description: The inspector still evaluates the application.
The inspector still records the finding.

incremental.description: The inspector reads an annex the checklist did not name.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the list of missing required fields. It disappears when the form has no field ids and the inspector reads it through. Evaluating the application stays with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research hazardous waste alternatives and costs.

steps.what: Total stored treatment costs when the quantity id exists.
Determine the magnitude and the disposal alternative.
Review the hazardous waste note before it is filed.

tasks.design: Treatment costs are totaled in the {ERP} only when the quantity id and the unit cost id are both stored. The inspector determines the magnitude of the hazardous waste problem and the disposal alternative. A note may cite only a total in that file. The total does not choose the alternative.
tasks.previous_blocker: Costs were taken from an old quote and written into the research note as if they were current.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored quantity and a stored unit cost can be totaled before the inspector writes.
tasks.still_hard: A waste with no quantity, and an alternative the cost does not decide.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see a low cost that is the wrong disposal for this waste.
tasks.altitude: Known quantities show a total. The inspector still determines the magnitude and the alternative. A missing id is not given a cost.

reach.task: Total a stored quantity and a unit cost and still choose the treatment.
reach.learn: The total can be prepared. The alternative stays here.

evidence.claim: A cost can be totaled from a quantity and a unit cost already stored. The total cannot choose the disposal alternative.
A record is filed only when the required ids are already stored. A drafted sentence may cite only a figure or a rule already in the file. A sentence with neither stops.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.
Fields: Quantity id and unit cost id, produced by the waste record. A line with a missing id is not totaled. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the cost records the organisation already keeps.
research_questions: What share of wastes have both ids?
Which alternatives are always decided in a meeting?

already_counted.description: The inspector still determines the magnitude and the alternative.
The inspector still reviews the note.

incremental.description: The inspector prices a waste the cost record did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the total where the quantity and the unit cost are already stored. It disappears when an id is missing and the inspector prices the waste. Choosing the alternative stays with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The inspector still runs the test, still talks to the public, and still evaluates the application. A result id, a stored sample, and a missing-field list can be ready before that work.
reach: Government property inspectors tell an owner what a stored result shows, and this job learns the conversation is not the result.
Regulatory affairs specialists check an application for missing fields, and this job learns the check does not grant the permit.
skills_to_grow: Keep the laboratory test and the public explanation with the inspector.
Cite a cost only when the quantity and the unit cost are already stored.
role.ambitious_version: Missing fields and stored quantities are ready before the inspector decides, and the test and the explanation are still done by that person.
